segments.comment: Variation of queued-notice-status-nested-monster-notice with accessiblemsg set, so every located message carries its prefix and show_glyph() raising the flag changes nothing. A debug-mode human Valkyrie maps the level with ^F so that walking raises no notices. She wishes fountains onto the three squares around the corner stairs, returns to the stairs, creates a yellow light and then a peaceful lichen (which nothing has announced yet, because no vision recalculation follows it), names the light with a 57-character name and slays it with #wizkill. wizcmds.c wiz_kill() prints "You kill <name>!", which nearly fills the top line, and calls mon.c xkilled(): m_detach() deletes the light source, which leaves a vision recalculation pending, and xkilled()'s own newsym() (3642) draws the fountain again while its gbuf entry is still new, so display.c show_glyph() (2011-2068) announces it through pline_xy() with a11y.accessiblemsg raised. That vpline() (pline.c 266-272) spends the recalculation first, whose vision.c notice_all_mons() prints hack.c notice_mon()'s line for the lichen with a location prefix, "(southeast): You see a peaceful lichen.", although accessiblemsg is off. The --More-- after the kill message shows HP:16(16) and Xp:1/0.
